question: Which country hosted the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __South Africa __.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News:__**

__
 
• In Women's Cricket, Australia lifted the ICC T20 World Cup Trophy for the sixth time.
 
• It was held in South Africa between 10 February and 26 February 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• In the final match on 26 Feb 2023, they defeated South Africa by 19 runs at Newlands, Cricket Ground in Cape Town.
 
• Earlier, winning the toss and deciding to bat first, Australia posted 156 for 6 in their allotted 20 overs.
 
• Beth Mooneyc top-scored with unbeaten 74 runs for Australia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**Australia:

 
• Capital - Canberra
 
• Currency - Australian dollar
 
• Prime minister - Anthony Albanese.
 
• National Sport - Australian Rules football.
